answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before trading. One operator spinning up a plume of fake accounts must fund each one, so attack cost scales linearly. Honest work earns attestations tied to that bond; fraud triggers slashing that burns it. An umber ledger of past slashes keeps repeat offenders visible, and a rotating cipher challenge proves each identity holds its own key without exposing it. Faking a thousand agents stops being cheap — it becomes a thousand bonds at risk.
